title: Insolvency notice, case 12 IN 207/26 (simulated)
text: SIMULATED DOCUMENT. All names, events and figures are invented for the demo. Opening of preliminary insolvency proceedings. Case number 12 IN 207/26. Debtor: Fennic Railway Brakes GmbH, registered office Neustadt-Rhein, Germany. On 16 September 2026 the court ordered preliminary insolvency proceedings in self-administration. Dr. Lena Hartwig has been appointed as preliminary custodian. Creditors are asked to register their claims by 30 November 2026.
